typography.heading: clear editorial landing; compact application hierarchy

design.density: Compact neutral workspace; 224px rail, clear context bar and function/result hierarchy

must: Follow the approved Hedera brand direction; official logo separate from product identity
Browser wallet signs; CLI/MCP/chat do not
Generic imported ABI forms inherit the same reusable theme
Real states and real data only
Keyboard focus, reduced motion and responsive layouts
avoid: Replacing EVM wallet architecture with unrelated Baku Privy auth

decisions.decision: User approved Slush fidelity for Workbench shell, palette, wallet menu, network selection and states; assistant is additive in that language.
Retain measured blue canvas/sidebar, green testnet indicator; adapt network action accents to blue mainnet/green testnet as requested.
Keep Hedera identity/domain and generic ABI-driven forms. No Slush trademarks or cartoon cast copied.

User requests full interface refinement retaining blue palette: connected product home, generic functions without Read/Write pills, real assistant states, searchable menus, branded agent access. Remove global Swap and plan-file upload. Controls use 12px radius; reduce nested surfaces.

Make contract switching visibly labeled and bordered; use one focus treatment and shared inline required-field validation. Ordinary reads omit wallet caller; explicit getter discovery applies only actual values with provenance, never inferred IDs or routes.

User approved the recommended black landing and neutral white/charcoal workspace with official Hedera colors and separate Built on Hedera logo. Supersedes Slush colors and shell geometry. Real contract preview leads; working assistant stays lower on landing. No fake data, global swap, contract classification or changes to core execution.
